newsitem.title: JAPAN: French President Chirac ends six-day Japan trip.
newsitem.headline: French President Chirac ends six-day Japan trip.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac left for home on Friday after winding up a six-day state visit to Japan.
During his visit, Chirac met Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda, Emperor Akihito and business leaders.
Chirac and Hashimoto signed an agreement entitled "20 Points For The Year 2000", designed to take Franco-Japanese relations to a higher plane.
It included agreements to hold annual summits, twice-yearly meetings of foreign ministers and to increase cooperation in space research.
Chirac also hammered home a message that it was time Europe, including France, seriously challenged the United States for business in Asia.
On Thursday, Chirac made a private visit to Japan's southern island of Kyushu to watch a sumo wrestling tournament.
